Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Purchased the Spirit II unit to replace a 1998 unit that was, in spite of maintenance, beginning to show its age. New Spirit has some improvements and some defects. Improvements are burners, flavor bars  and gas canister support. Previous Spirit was all metal frame and very solid, new spirit not so. Previous Spirit very easy to move around. The new one lacks any handle to move it and it and if you try to use the shelf, which appears to be the new handle, it collapses. Very poor design, other similar barbecues are better designed. I had replaced the grates and flavor bars on the 98' unit with stainless steel and will do so on this one as soon as at the cast grates start to fail as I am sure they will. Stainless holds up better and does not have to be periodically replaced.
My over all impression of the new Spirit is good, but not perfect. Weber produces reliable products and I will continue to purchase as the problematic  areas I mentioned can be addressed.
Results.Title: Good, But Not Perfect

At that point you'll need to turn the grill down to a lower setting, because it tends to keep heating up.  The only negative I can think of with this grill happens when cooking fatty meat.
